thread:
incident-bot: P1 page — GPU pool eu-west-1-small saturated, autoscaler failing to add nodes (queue growth > 10k). Paging oncall SRE: sara. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-capacity.md

sara (oncall-sre): I'm awake, looking. Can someone post the current queue length and throttle errors?

lina (support): multiple customer reports from EU region — requests timing out with 504s. CS notes: 'critical for nightly batch' from cust: DataGlyph.

mike (infra): alerting metrics — q_len=11,342, token_rate down 32%, autoscaler errors showing: `scaleup failed: quota_exceeded` and `RateLimitExceeded` to cloud provider. Also seeing kube-operator crashloop in eu-west-1.

jess (ops): rolling logs: ```
2026-03-15T02:12:03Z autoscaler ERROR: reconcile failed: provider API 429
2026-03-15T02:12:05Z queue service WARN: enqueue-delay high, 120s
2026-03-15T02:12:10Z pool-manager INFO: pool eu-west-1-small saturated
```

anil (runtime): runtime health looks ok but KV cache hit drops 60% due to evictions — makes per-request cost spike. Suggest immediate mitigation: redirect low-priority traffic to cpu-fallback pool or smaller model variant.

sara (oncall-sre): quick mitigation steps I'm going to try: 1) scale down non-prod pools in EU, 2) enable manual scale up on dedicated-reserve pool, 3) flip routing policy to prefer us-east as fallback for non-SLA customers. Will post commands.

mike (infra): +1. I'm looking at quota dashboard — we hit ephemeral GPU quota for eu-west region; provider is rejecting new instances. I can request emergency quota but that's slow. We have reserved dedicated capacity in us-east that we can flip.

sara (oncall-sre): running commands now: ```
# drain non-prod workloads from eu-west-1-small
kubectl label nodes -l env=non-prod eu-west-1-small node-role.kubernetes.io/drain=true
# promote dedicated-reserve to active
redwoodctl capacity set dedicated-reserve --region eu-west-1 --state active --priority emergency
```

deploy-bot: deploy triggered by sara: promote-reserve-2026-03-15 / started

jess (ops): I'm notifying customers via status page with initial message. Lina, can you coordinate targeted emails for DataGlyph and two other paying customers?

lina (support): On it. Draft: "We are experiencing elevated latency and timeouts for EU inference requests caused by GPU capacity constraints; engineering is mitigating. We'll update in 15 minutes."

anil (runtime): while promote-reserve is pending, we can apply a fast fallback in the routing layer: set model_variant=small-quantized for non-SLA and reduce batch size to keep latency in check. I'll push a route change.

sara (oncall-sre): route change applied: `route set --region eu-west-1 --match customer_tier!=enterprise --model small-quantized --batch-size 8` — monitoring queue.

mike (infra): promote-reserve failed: provider still returning 429 on create. Operator logs show cloud API token refresh failing intermittently. I'm rotating provider API token now.

jess (ops): update: status page updated, public ETA TBD. Reactions: :hourglass_flowing_sand: :rotating_light:

mike (infra): rotated token, retried promote-reserve, now allocating 6 reserved gpus. Autoscaler still unhappy for on-demand nodes due to quota, but dedicated reserve active. Queue length falling: 11,342 -> 4,900 in 4 minutes.

sara (oncall-sre): good. Observed request 95p latency improved from 12s to 2.1s for routed traffic. Switching on manual eviction of long-sitting queue items for non-SLA to free up slots.

anil (runtime): KV cache warming in reserve pools — hit rate recovering. Suggest we keep route change for 2h while we confirm stable.

product-ops: Heads-up — some customers saw inference model downgrade (small-quantized) which may affect output quality. Need to prepare comms and possible credits.

lina (support): DataGlyph wants a timeline and log extract. We provided initial note and asked to join a bridge if they want live updates.

sara (oncall-sre): I will start a brief incident bridge and capture actions, then handoff to day SRE in 45m. Bridge: zoom.internal/incident-3099991234.

deploy-bot: promote-reserve-2026-03-15 completed in 00:06:12

jess (ops): post-mitigation check: queue now 2,100, throttles gone. Marking incident as mitigated for customer impact. Still investigating root cause of autoscaler failure and provider 429 storm.

mike (infra): preliminary root cause notes: provider reached regional ephemeral GPU allocation limits due to surge; autoscaler retried aggressively causing provider rate-limiting (429). Also operator crashloop from a race during token refresh. We'll collect kube-operator logs and provider API traces.

sara (oncall-sre): action items (quick):
- Emergency: keep route fallback for 2h (owner: anil)
- Infra: production rotate for provider token + add retry backoff to operator (owner: mike)
- Capacity: request permanent quota increase with provider for eu-west-1 (owner: mike)
- Product/Support: customer comms and credits plan for impacted accounts (owner: lina / product-ops)
- Postmortem: full incident doc scheduled, include timeline and cost impact (owner: sara)

anil (runtime): I'll open a change to make small-quantized the auto-fallback variant and add telemetry to track quality regressions.

lina (support): DataGlyph accepted bridge invite for 02:50Z, wants a short post-incident summary.

product-ops: Please capture any SLA violations for billing reconciliation.

sara (oncall-sre): Handoff: I'll stay until the bridge and then hand to day SRE Mike at 03:00Z. Leaving a short runbook note in incident tracker. Reactions: :white_check_mark:

mike (infra): will pick up after 03:00Z, will follow up on operator backoff patch and quota request.

incident-bot: Incident marked mitigated -> monitoring. Created incident ticket INC-2026-0315-309999 for postmortem.
